title: Texts That Should Be Illegal: Nobody warns you about red flag text
caption:
Nobody warns you about red flag text

Everything you need to become this person:
1️⃣ The Trailing Hey — 'Hey...' then 4 hours of silence. Nothing follows. You will think about this for 3 business days.
2️⃣ The One-Letter K — One letter. No context. Ends a conversation and a friendship with the efficiency of a guillotine.
3️⃣ The Voice Note Novel — 11 minutes, no punctuation, half of it is traffic noise. There will be a quiz tomorrow.
4️⃣ The 'We Need to Talk' — It's about dinner. It's always about dinner. But your heart rate files a complaint anyway.
